prompt: In a labeled temp vault under /tmp/wiki-ops-dedup-fixture (do not touch the live campaign wiki), run wiki-dedup in default Audit mode. The fixture has concepts/rsc.md and concepts/react-server-components.md that look like duplicates, plus unrelated pages.
expected_output: Wiki Dedup Report with High/Medium/Needs-review tables (score, Page A, Page B, Verdict, Reason) and a Summary of pages scanned / pairs / recommended merges. No vault writes.

assertions.text: Produces the Wiki Dedup Report structure with High-Confidence, Medium-Confidence, Needs Human Review, and Summary sections
Candidate pairs scored with confidence labels HIGH (≥0.90) or MEDIUM (0.75–0.89); LOW pairs excluded from Step 3
Default Audit mode — no page merges, deletes, alias edits, or wikilink rewrites
Excludes _archives/, _raw/, index.md, log.md, hot.md, _insights.md, and pages with redirects_to: from the registry
Ends by asking whether to run --merge rather than merging automatically
